{{Top|leg}}
'''Borium''' was a valuable [[Ore/Legends|ore]].<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>

Valuable for its industrial and manufacturing applications, borium was useful for, among other things, borium-tipped excavators and [[Drill/Legends|industrial drills]], and its role in [[starship]] production.<ref name="STRONG">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

Borium was heavily present on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> world [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]], where it played a significant part in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] economy.<ref name="STRONG" />
